result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but one clear rendering defect stands out: the metadata line under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has two text fragments drawn on top of each other, which makes the delivery time and fee unreadable. The partially visible carousel item and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scrolling behaviour and are not reported.

issues.description: In the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card's metadata row, the delivery time (about '25–35 min') and the delivery fee text ('€0 delivery') overlap each other. The result is garbled text reading roughly '25–35€0mdelivery', so neither value can be read. Only the trailing '• Ramen' is legible.
issues.suggestion: Place the time, fee and cuisine as separate inline or flex items with proper spacing and separators (for example '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen'). Remove any absolute positioning or negative margins that let the segments collide, and check the row with long and short values.
